Summary 
 
Experienced Power Platform Consultant specializing in the design and delivery of enterprise -grade business 
applications using Power Apps (Canvas and Model-Driven). Strong expertise in building scalable, secure, and 
user-centric applications leveraging Dataverse, SharePoint, and SQL Server as backend data sources, with 
advanced workflow automation using Power Automate. 
 
Proven experience modernizing classic SharePoint forms and workflows, migrating them into responsive 
Canvas Apps and custom Model-Driven applications, and ensuring seamless functionality across desktop and 
mobile platforms. I am skilled in customizing classic and modern SharePoint pages and forms, implementing 
governance and security strategies, and optimizing performance for high-volume enterprise environments. 
 
Hands-on experience designing and implementing AI-assisted solutions using Microsoft Copilot Studio and 
Custom Copilots, enabling conversational workflows, contextual data access, and productivity enhancements 
within Microsoft 365 and Power Platform applications. Experienced in integrating Copilot with Dataverse, 
SharePoint, and Power Automate while applying security, compliance, and role-based access controls. 
 
Strong background in building reusable component libraries, custom controls, and implementing role -based 
security models for enterprise applications. Adept at collaborating with stakeholders to align solutions with 
business processes and operational requirements. 
 
Additional expertise includes Azure development and Microsoft Fabric, supporting integration with cloud 
services, data pipelines, analytics platforms, and scalable storage solutions. This hybrid skill set enables 
delivery of process-centric, data-driven, and AI-enabled solutions that support advanced reporting and secure 
enterprise connectivity. 
 
Recognized for transforming manual and legacy processes into automated, intelligent, and user -friendly 
solutions. Combines strong technical expertise with client-focused delivery to improve efficiency, drive user 
adoption, and ensure long-term scalability across Microsoft 365 ecosystems.
